name: Tinoto Invoice and Shipping Labels
author: ariasystem

sections.description:
Tinoto Invoice and Shipping Labels creates printable invoices and shipping labels for WooCommerce orders.

Features:

  • Multiple invoice templates.
  • Multiple shipping-label templates.
  • A5 as the default invoice print size.
  • Separate invoice and shipping-label logos.
  • Printable invoice output.
  • HTML and PDF invoice output.
  • PDF invoice delivery to the customer’s email through the WordPress mail system.
  • Persian (Jalali) date display and right-to-left layouts.
  • Custom footer or thank-you text.
  • Optional fixed-amount or percentage discount code for a future purchase.
  • Configurable invoice fields and display options.

Email delivery depends on the site’s WordPress mail or SMTP configuration.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP through Plugins > Add New, or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate Tinoto Invoice and Shipping Labels.
  3. Open the plugin settings and configure store information, logos, templates and print options.
  4. Open a WooCommerce order to create its invoice or shipping label.
sections.faq:
Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin is designed for WooCommerce orders.

Can shipping labels use a separate logo?

Yes. You can select a separate shipping-label logo. If none is selected, the invoice logo can be used.

Does it support A5?

Yes. A5 is the default invoice print size.

Can the PDF invoice be emailed to the customer?

Yes. The plugin uses the WordPress mail system. Successful delivery depends on the site’s email or SMTP configuration.

Does it support Persian dates and RTL layouts?

Yes. It includes Persian (Jalali) date display and Persian-friendly right-to-left layouts.
